item: The local AI is reached directly, never through a system proxy, and an Ollama the app starts listens only on this computer
key_paths: src/llm/ollama.py; src/llm/vllm_client.py; src/llm/ollama_lifecycle.py; src/llm/arbitration.py; src/ai_layer/model_bench.py; tests/test_local_ai_direct_and_bound.py
summary: R770: OllamaClient and VllmClient now pass trust_env=False; with HTTP(S)_PROXY or ALL_PROXY set, httpx had sent even http://127.0.0.1 through the proxy, so prompts and article text could reach it. Proven against a counting proxy on 127.0.0.1 with a control; a parse-tree sweep requires trust_env=False on every httpx client in src and refuses aliases, subclasses, getattr, a client's own proxy/mounts/transport and HTTPTransport/Proxy (each evasion planted and caught). R771: the spawned ollama serve gets OLLAMA_HOST = the configured loopback host:port, never an inherited 0.0.0.0, and no inherited OLLAMA_ORIGINS; a remote address, an unreadable port, port 0 or https spawns nothing; alias names go as literals, plain localhost as a name (ruled). A GPU handover refuses before releasing vLLM for any address start() would refuse; a running daemon is reported running first; a low port that never answers says why. Row 234 follow-ups: the address is named before a missing binary.
